# Michigan Virtual

> Michigan Virtual provides comprehensive K-12 online learning solutions with 200+ courses, credit recovery programs, and professional development resources for students, educators, and families.

Michigan Virtual is a leading provider of virtual education serving Michigan students and educators. The platform offers Advanced Placement courses, middle school and high school offerings, homeschool programs, and professional development through its Professional Learning Portal, all supported by Michigan-certified teachers and comprehensive student support services.

## Key Topics

- Online Learning
- K-12 Education
- Virtual Courses

## Student Learning Programs

- [Online High School and Middle School Courses - For Students](https://michiganvirtual.org/students): Main student portal with 200+ online courses, AP offerings, and credit recovery
- [Student Courses](https://michiganvirtual.org/courses/students): Searchable online course catalog for high school and middle school students
- [Michigan Virtual Middle School Courses](https://michiganvirtual.org/students/middle-school): Middle school course offerings in core and elective subjects
- [Essentials Credit Recovery & Alternative Learning](https://michiganvirtual.org/students/essentials): Essentials program for credit recovery and alternative learning solutions
- [Homeschool Programs](https://michiganvirtual.org/students/homeschool-programs): 200+ online courses for homeschool students with Michigan-certified teacher support
- [Michigan Cares](https://michiganvirtual.org/sel/michigan-cares): Free social-emotional learning resource for grades 3-12 mental health support

## Student & Family Resources

- [Student Guide to Online Learning](https://michiganvirtual.org/resources/guides/student-guide): Comprehensive guide for students on online learning preparation and success strategies
- [Parent Guide to Online Learning](https://michiganvirtual.org/resources/guides/parent-guide): Parent guide to supporting students in online learning environments
- [2025-2026 School Year Calendar](https://michiganvirtual.org/students/calendar): School year calendar with enrollment dates, semester schedules, and drop policies
- [Resources](https://michiganvirtual.org/resources): Educational guides, tools, reports, and learning resources for online education

## Professional Development & Educator Resources

- [Mentors](https://michiganvirtual.org/professionals/mentors): Mentor resources and professional development for online learning support
- [Counselors](https://michiganvirtual.org/professionals/counselors): Professional development courses for school counselors and college counseling

## Support & System Status

- [Support](https://michiganvirtual.org/about/support): Customer support hub with knowledge base and help ticket submission
- [Solutions](https://help.michiganvirtual.org/support/solutions): Support solutions for Professional Learning Portal and online learning platforms
- [Service Updates](https://michiganvirtual.org/service): System status and service update alerts for platform maintenance and upgrades

## Optional

- [Careers at Michigan Virtual](https://michiganvirtual.org/about/careers): Job opportunities and careers page for Michigan Virtual staff positions
